entities.summary: Sara Anna van de Geer is a Dutch mathematical statistician who is a professor in the department of mathematics at ETH Zurich. Her main research areas include empirical process theory, statistical learning theory, and nonparametric and high-dimensional statistics. She is the daughter of psychologist John P. van de Geer.
